newsitem.title: USA: Becton, Dickinson to acquire Difco.
newsitem.headline: Becton, Dickinson to acquire Difco.

text.p: Becton, Dickinson and Co said on Wednesday that it has agreed to acquire Difco Laboratories Inc for an undisclosed amount of cash.
Difco is a Michigan-based maker of microbiology media and supplies.
Becton Dickinson expects to complete the acquisition promptly following approval by Difco's shareholders and receipt of required governmental approvals and clearances, it said.
Difco's revenues for the year ended December 31, 1996, excluding the blood culture business that it had sold, totaled $82 million.
